tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows elevated creatinine, suggesting impaired renal function, and high chloride, which may indicate an electrolyte imbalance. Markedly elevated total bilirubin and mildly increased ALT suggest possible hepatobiliary dysfunction or cholestasis. Other parameters are within normal limits. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation of liver and kidney function are recommended.
